courses.summary: 本課聚焦永磁材料、轉子拓樸、反電勢與退磁餘裕。地圖提供公開研究或產業交流的背景；本課的模型和假設不宣稱在該處實測、發明或量產。
courses.summaryEn: This course focuses on magnet materials, rotor topology, back-EMF and demagnetization margin. The map provides public research/industry context; course models and assumptions are not claimed to have been measured, invented or manufactured there.

history.title: TI 名稱形成
history.text: 官方資料記錄公司源於 1930 年的 GSI，1951 年更名為 Texas Instruments；本課以其公開控制文件連結元件與機電系統。
history.textEn: Official records trace the company to GSI in 1930 and the Texas Instruments name in 1951; this course uses public control documentation to connect devices with electromechanical systems.

history.title: 積體電路成為控制技術基礎
history.text: TI 官方歷史記載 Jack Kilby 在 1958 年的積體電路工作。今天的即時馬達控制結合量測、計算和功率元件；地圖代表控制產業脈絡，不是本課所有設備產地。
history.textEn: TI’s history records Jack Kilby’s integrated-circuit work in 1958. Modern real-time motor control combines sensing, computation and power devices; this map indicates industry context, not the origin of all course equipment.

courses.connection: 從比較表貼與內埋磁鐵的課程問題出發，依來源追溯研究、元件供應與系統驗證的分工；代表地點不等於完整供應鏈。
courses.connectionEn: Start with compare surface and interior magnets and trace roles in research, components and system validation; the reference location does not represent the entire supply chain.

roles.businessEn: Electrification, motors and drives, wind converters and power-quality products.

roles.role: 生產永磁馬達，可對照反電動勢。

roles.businessEn: Motors from precision to large industrial, drives and switched-reluctance machines.

roles.role: 生產稀土磁石，可對照本課的磁石材料與去磁餘裕。
roles.roleEn: Makes rare-earth magnets, relevant to magnet materials and demagnetization margin here.
roles.business: 矽晶圓、光阻、光罩基板與稀土磁石等材料。
roles.businessEn: Silicon wafers, photoresists, photomask substrates and rare-earth magnets among other materials.

courses.connection: 從「永磁同步馬達製造」的材料、設備、設計、量測或系統整合問題，延伸查閱下列公司與機構的官方資料；這是教材關聯，不代表合作、採購、背書或投資建議。
courses.connectionEn: Explore official information from companies and institutions related to the materials, equipment, design, measurement or system integration in Permanent-magnet synchronous-motor manufacturing. This is a learning association, not a partnership, procurement, endorsement or investment advice.
